characters.name: antimage
lines: Magic. Everywhere I look, magic.
I'll start with the staff, then the fingers.
Your mana is a loan. I'm the collections agent.
Tell them the mage-less age... has begun.

characters.name: axe
lines: Nobody asks the axe where it's been.
Come closer. I'm told I'm very persuasive.
Culling blade! And by blade, I mean the whole axe.
Missed. How... embarrassing.

characters.name: bane
lines: Sweet dreams. I'll be in all of them.
Sleep now. Scream later. That's the schedule.
Grip of terror! It's like a hug, if hugs were lawsuits.
Waking up is overrated anyway.

characters.name: bloodseeker
lines: I can smell you from here. That's a complaint.
Running only makes it warmer. And redder.
Rupture! Do try to walk it off. Slowly.
Ironically... bleeding out.

characters.name: crystal_maiden
lines: Bring a coat. Actually, bring three.
Everyone hold still. Frostbite is much less funny if you flinch.
Freezing field! Weather's lovely, isn't it?
Thawing. Already plotting.

characters.name: drow_ranger
lines: Wind's up. So am I.
Frost arrows. They're complimentary with every shot.
Silence the back line. Then the front line. Then the noise.
The cold... finally got in.

characters.name: earthshaker
lines: Ground's been restless. Same as me.
Everyone gather round! No, closer. Closer!
Echo slam!... That was everyone, wasn't it?
The ground... took me back.

characters.name: juggernaut
lines: The mask stays on. It's not a phase.
Blade fury! Spinning is not a dance. Do not clap.
Omnislash. Try to keep up. You won't.
Unmasked. Disappointing, I know.

characters.name: morphling
lines: Solid. For now. Let's see how long that lasts.
I'll be whatever this needs me to be.
Adaptive strike! Strength, agility, or just general menace?
Going... liquid. See you in the puddle.

characters.name: phantom_lancer
lines: One of me? Which one?
Pick a target. Any of them. Any of us.
Spirit lance! And a few hundred of my closest friends.
Which one died? Doesn't matter. I felt it.

characters.name: sand_king
lines: Burrowing. Socialising later.
Sand's warm today. You'll find out why.
Epicenter! Hold on... this takes a moment. Terrifying moment.
Scattered. Reassembling was always the hard part.

characters.name: storm_spirit
lines: Late! Late! Always late!
Zip. Zap. Regret. That's the full rotation.
Ball lightning! I'm already behind you. Hello.
Out of charge. Out of everything.

characters.name: vengefulspirit
lines: I remember what you did. All of it.
Revenge is a dish best served repeatedly.
Wave of terror! Also known as my personality.
Even death doesn't settle this.

characters.name: windrunner
lines: Wind's got my back. Literally. It's pushing.
Shackleshot! Two for one, if the geometry cooperates.
Focus fire! Try not to miss. I'll be insufferable if you do.
Wind... stopped.

characters.name: lich
lines: Frost armour. Complimentary eternal winter.
I've died before. It didn't take.
Chain frost! It'll find you. It's very persistent.
Again? This is getting repetitive.

characters.name: shadow_shaman
lines: Hex first, questions never.
I brought wards. Many, many wards.
Mass serpent ward! They're not pets. They're arguments.
The wards... outlive me. As planned.

characters.name: tidehunter
lines: Tide's in. So am I.
Anchor's heavier than you. That's a threat.
Ravage! Everyone up! Everyone down!
Back to the deep. Bring snacks next time.

characters.name: witch_doctor
lines: I have a prescription. It's a bouncing skull.
Cask! It goes where it wants. Mostly at you.
Death ward! Stand in it. That's not a request.
The spirits... want a word.

characters.name: enigma
lines: I was here before the map. I'll be here after.
Three of me is the minimum viable approach.
Black hole. Please gather. Attendance is mandatory.
Collapsing. Briefly.

characters.name: tinker
lines: March of the machines! And the march of my ego.
Rockets. So many rockets. It's a bit much, I know.
Rearm! Everything's reusable if you're stubborn enough.
My machines... keep going. Lucky them.

characters.name: necrolyte
lines: Death pulse. Everyone gets one. Fair's fair.
You're already dying. I'm just tidying.
Reaper's scythe! No paperwork required.
Heartstopper... finally stopped mine.

characters.name: warlock
lines: I brought a friend. He's enormous and furious.
Fatal bonds! You're in this together. Unfortunately.
Chaotic offering! Meet the golem. Don't.
The golem... outlives the warlock. Cruel design.

characters.name: beastmaster
lines: Hawk, boar, me. In that order of charm.
Wild axes! They come back. Like regrets.
Primal roar! I've been saving that one.
The beasts... carry on without me.

characters.name: queenofpain
lines: Scream now, or I'll take it as rude.
Sonic wave! Do try not to enjoy it.
Blink, strike, smile. In whatever order amuses me.
Pain... was always going to be mutual.

characters.name: venomancer
lines: Poison's polite. It takes its time.
Plague wards. They're complimentary.
Poison nova! Everyone gets a little something.
Rotting. It's the family business.

characters.name: faceless_void
lines: Time's a suggestion. I don't take suggestions.
I've seen this fight. You lose.
Chronosphere! Everyone freeze. I'll wait.
Time... caught up. Rude.

characters.name: skeleton_king
lines: Kneel. It's a formality, but do it.
Strike me down. Seriously, go ahead. I'll wait.
Reincarnation! Third time's the charm. Fifth, really.
Down again. Give it a moment.

characters.name: death_prophet
lines: The spirits are chatty today. Unfortunate for you.
Exorcism! I'll just stand here and be spooky.
Spirit siphon. Sharing is caring.
The spirits... finally went quiet.

characters.name: phantom_assassin
lines: You won't see it. That's the point.
Blur! I'm everywhere and also not.
Coup de grace. If it lands. If.
Even shadows... get found eventually.

characters.name: templar_assassin
lines: Refraction's up. Hit me. I dare you.
Meld. Now you see me, now you really don't.
Psi blades! Cutting through more than one of you.
Focus... broken.

characters.name: dragon_knight
lines: Shield, lance, patience. Then fire.
Dragon tail! I've been holding that in.
Elder dragon form! Big, scaly, and finally comfortable.
Back to human. Always a comedown.

characters.name: life_stealer
lines: Rage! Everything's food. Everything.
Infest. I'll be inside. Metaphorically. No, literally.
Feast! Thank you, thank you, I'll be here all week.
Unrage. Cold. Hungry. Rude.

characters.name: dark_seer
lines: Ion shell. Wear it. It's flammable.
Vacuum! Everyone in the middle, please.
Wall of replica! Meet yourselves. I'll wait.
Even the copies... fade.

characters.name: omniknight
lines: Purification. You're welcome in advance.
Guardian angel! Don't waste it. I see you.
Repel! Physical-only, for now.
The light... takes me. Worth it.

characters.name: enchantress
lines: Untouchable. Not a personality flaw, a feature.
Enchant! You're on my side now. Congratulations.
Impetus! Distance makes the heart grow... louder.
Even the forest... lets go.

characters.name: night_stalker
lines: Daylight's a rumour. I don't believe in it.
Darkness! Finally, decent working conditions.
Void! Now nobody can see me cheating.
The sun. Every time. The sun.

characters.name: broodmother
lines: Children! Everywhere! Mind the webs.
Spin web. It's structural. And sticky.
Insatiable hunger! That's the whole plan, honestly.
The brood... scatters.

characters.name: bounty_hunter
lines: Tracked. Tagged. Billed.
Jinada! That's a discount, not a warning.
Shuriken! Bounces if you line up. Please line up.
Bounty... collected. Mine.

characters.name: batrider
lines: Hold tight. The bat does not brake.
Flamebreak! Fire's a navigational aid now.
Flaming lasso! You're coming with me. No luggage.
Bat's fine. I'm the problem.

characters.name: spectre
lines: I'm already here. Behind you. Always.
Haunt! Everyone gets a visit.
Reality! Can't run from what's everywhere.
Back to the veil. See you soon.

characters.name: doom_bringer
lines: Doom. That's the whole sentence.
I ate something for this. You don't want details.
Doom! Sit down. Stop healing. Stop everything.
Doomed. Fitting, I suppose.

characters.name: ancient_apparition
lines: Ice blast. It travels. It waits. It arrives.
Cold feet! Literally. Stop moving.
Ice vortex. Ruining picnics across the map.
Thawing. The Universe carries on.

characters.name: spirit_breaker
lines: CHARGE! ...Nobody move. I can't steer.
Greater bash! Momentum is a personality type.
Nether strike! Here I come. Eventually.
Unstoppable. Was. Past tense. Ouch.

characters.name: gyrocopter
lines: Rotors up! Don't stand behind me.
Rocket barrage! I'm not sure how many I brought.
Call down! Two missiles, one very bad day.
Going down! I mean it this time.

characters.name: alchemist
lines: Greed first. Consequences later.
Unstable concoction! Shake well. Do not shake well.
Chemical rage! Look at me, I'm enormous.
Even gold... doesn't help here.

characters.name: invoker
lines: Ten spells. I'll use eleven.
Sun strike! Global delivery, no tracking number.
Tornado, EMP, meteor. In that order if you're lucky.
Out of orbs. Out of patience.

characters.name: silencer
lines: Quiet. That's the whole ability. Quiet.
Global silence! Everyone stop talking. Now.
Glaives of wisdom! The smarter you are, the worse this hurts.
Silenced. Finally. Peaceful, actually.

characters.name: obsidian_destroyer
lines: Imprisonment. Time out. Indefinite.
Arcane orb! Bigger brain, bigger hit.
Sanity's eclipse! Enjoy the headache.
Mind... goes dark. Fitting.

characters.name: brewmaster
lines: Three of me, and none of us agree.
Thunder clap! And a drink, afterwards.
Primal split! Earth, storm, fire, and a lot of shouting.
Reassembling. Somebody get me a chair.

characters.name: shadow_demon
lines: Shadow poison! It stacks. So do my grudges.
Disruption! Meet your doubles. They're worse.
Demonic purge! Everything off. Everything.
Back to the shadows. They missed me.

characters.name: lone_druid
lines: Me, the bear, and poor communication.
Bear's faster than me. Bear goes first.
True form! Finally, the good one.
Bear's fine. I'm the one who fell.

characters.name: chaos_knight
lines: Odds are in my favour. Probably.
Reality rift! You, me, and no witnesses.
Phantasm! Four of me, one of you. You do the maths.
Chaos... went the other way.

characters.name: ogre_magi
lines: Two heads, one plan. The plan is hitting.
Fireblast! Multicast! Again! Again!
Bloodlust! On me? On me. Yes. Good.
One head's still talking. So, fine.

characters.name: undying
lines: Flesh golem. I've been working on my physique.
Decay! Strength, borrowed. Permanently.
Tombstone! Hit it. That's not a challenge, it's a threat.
Undying. Turns out, loosely.

characters.name: disruptor
lines: Static storm! Hold that thought. And everything else.
Glimpse! You were just there. Go back.
Thunder strike! Location: you.
Storm... fizzles out.

characters.name: naga_siren
lines: Song of the siren. nap time, everyone.
Ensnare! The sea's got a grip on you.
Rip tide! Armour's optional, apparently.
The song... stops.

characters.name: keeper_of_the_light
lines: Illuminate! Hold on, this takes a moment.
Blinding light! Mind the horse.
Will-o-wisp! Everyone gather. Gently.
The light... dims. Someone else's turn.

characters.name: troll_warlord
lines: Whirling axes! Some ranged, some not. All angry.
Battle trance! Everyone hit faster. Including me.
Fervour! I'm building up to something. Stand by.
Trolls... don't stay down. Usually.

characters.name: magnataur
lines: Skewer! Everyone line up. No, in a row.
Reverse polarity! All of you. Here. Now.
Empower! Somebody's getting very strong. Guess who.
Horn's... bent. Finally.

characters.name: bristleback
lines: Quills out. Back's fine. You're not.
Go visit my back. I insist. It's worse there.
Warpath! Every spell makes me faster. That's just rude.
Quills... retract. Rude.

characters.name: tusk
lines: Snowball! Everyone in. No pushing. Yes pushing.
Walrus punch! It's a one-hit. Singular. Final.
Ice shards and a very bad attitude.
Cold. Finally. And I'd know.

characters.name: skywrath_mage
lines: The sky is speaking. Rude, but accurate.
Arcane bolt! Small, fast, frequent. Like me.
Mystic flare! Stand still. You won't, but do.
The sky... goes quiet.

characters.name: abaddon
lines: Shield up. Hit me. I dare you. Seriously.
Borrowed time! I'll pay it back. Eventually.
Mist coil! Heals me, hurts you. Efficient.
Borrowed time's... due.

characters.name: legion_commander
lines: Duel! One of us walks away. Statistically, me.
Overwhelming odds! I brought the whole lane.
Press the attack! Faster, stronger, louder.
Lost the duel. Won the argument, though.

characters.name: ember_spirit
lines: Three remnants, one very bad idea.
Sleight of fist! Everyone gets hit at once. Efficient.
Activate fire remnant! Wait, which one?
Embers... out.

characters.name: earth_spirit
lines: Rolling boulder! Coming through, no brakes.
Boulder smash! Rock's got opinions now.
Geomagnetic grip! Pulling you in. Gently. No.
Boulder... becomes a rock. Just a rock.

characters.name: phoenix
lines: Fire spirits! Four, and they don't come back.
Sun ray! It's a laser. It's fine. It's not fine.
Supernova! I'm an egg now. Please defend the egg.
Back to ash. Back to an egg. Back again.

characters.name: oracle
lines: False promise! Healing's delayed. So's the screaming.
Purifying flames! It heals. Trust me. Mostly.
Fate's edict! You're magic-immune and completely useless.
Fate... caught up.

characters.name: winter_wyvern
lines: Winter's curse! Everyone attack your friend. Awkward.
Splinter blast! It bounces. A lot.
Cold embrace! You're safe and completely useless. You're welcome.
The wyvern... cools.

characters.name: arc_warden
lines: Tempest double! Meet me. I'm insufferable.
Spark wraith! It waits. Patiently. Forever, if needed.
Flux! Standing still was a mistake.
The double... goes first. Thankfully.
